name: FUNHOUSE (PLAYTEST)
desc:
(This is pre-pre-alpha bugs can still be present rn)
The show never ends in purgatory.

FUNHOUSE is a roguelike game, directed and developed by VibingLeaf, Yoonie (Zvmbiegerl) and Nullkitz.
Each playable character features a distinct gameplay style and set of abilities to contribute to the team.

Currently, this game is in a DEMO state, meaning very few of the characters from the roster are present, and a lot more is planned for this game. A story mode is planned as well, but for now we have endless mode.

KEEP IN MIND: GAME IS SUBJECT TO BUGS, REPORT IF FOUND ANY
AND WE ACTIVELY LOOK FOR YOUR FEEDBACK!
